content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-83. - Manner of payment.
content.summary:
Payment from funds of the retirement system shall be made by the order of the board
               of trustees or the treasurer, signed by any two of three signatures as authorized
               by resolution of the board from time-to-time.
(Code 1960, § 19-19(C); Code 1981, § 26-39)
